ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Freeze on Local Communities
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of Trump's funding freeze on local communities and the potential consequences for economic growth and development
questions: What are the specific effects of the funding freeze on local communities?
How can communities mitigate the impact of the funding freeze?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant issues with federal funding and its impact on local communities. By analyzing data and public records, we can determine the extent of the issue and identify potential solutions.
